scope: Owner CLI presentation change (packages/textbutler/src/cli.ts, owner-cli.ts, runtime-entry.ts, tui.ts, onboarding.ts, plus new cli-help.ts, cli-style.ts and version.ts): grouped and glossed help with help <topic>, --version, one-line usage errors with a closest-match suggestion (exit 2), JSON output only with --json or a detected agent audience, a human doctor report on a terminal, and a quiet exit when stdout closes early. No change to control requests, sends, grants, journaling, provider access or daemon lifecycle.

blockers: The guided terminal's error handler only knew OwnerCliError, so a CliUsageError from setup or an owner command printed the uncertain-send warning. Fixed: tui.ts now prints the usage message and its next command.
checked: A trailing --json is never stripped from replies send text.
--data-dir and --json work in either order, for output and for errors.
Every owner command group has a help topic, and suggestions route to real topics.
Usage errors exit 2; the build test was updated for it.
doctor prints JSON only with --json or for an agent audience.
Closing stdout early (| head) exits quietly.

result: Ship. Presentation-only change to owner-facing output; the one blocker was fixed before merge.
